The Herman Fuller tag is the result of a retcon. SCP-1931, the initial HF article, established Fuller's show as having been the circus Jester ran away to.

It's not necessarily what I had in mind when I wrote this tale, but I don't have a problem with it either.

item.content:encoded: I suppose that depends on which language you're using- in Hebrew it's not, but it might be in Yiddish. I do need to point out Matzot don't really come in lumps- they look like boards. Unless again you are referring to Matza balls, but that's something different. Yes, I know this is nitpicky as all hell, but I'm a translator, it's what I do.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Wikipedia informs me that both spellings are acceptable.

Jester being Jewish is just what popped into my head while I was developing the character. Being part of a historically oppressed minority sort of parallels his own life story as an outsider who's feared and shunned by mainstream society - and like many American Jews in the mid-20th century, he finally finds acceptance and success in show business.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: That's probably because it's not "the real Jester". It's a reimagining, much like the remade Battlestar Galactica didn't have much of anything to do with the original. I started with the core idea ("goblin who dresses like a jester") and went from there to see how I could make him into a sympathetic character.

item.content:encoded: As a followup to my Ziggy tale, I now present the latest installment in what i'm thinking of calling "Reimagination Theatre". Today, we take one of the most infamous SCPs to come around in recent memory, and look at him from a whole new perspective.
